meta.name: geomaster
meta.description: Comprehensive geospatial science skill covering remote sensing, GIS, spatial analysis, machine learning for earth observation, and 30+ scientific domains. Supports satellite imagery processing (Sentinel, Landsat, MODIS, SAR, hyperspectral), vector and raster data operations, spatial statistics, point cloud processing, network analysis, cloud-native workflows (STAC, COG, Planetary Computer), and 8 programming languages (Python, R, Julia, JavaScript, C++, Java, Go, Rust) with 500+ code examples. Use for remote sensing workflows, GIS analysis, spatial ML, Earth observation data processing, terrain analysis, hydrological modeling, marine spatial analysis, atmospheric science, and any geospatial computation task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析卫星影像与地理空间数据,构建空间机器学习模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理卫星影像和地理空间数据,需要多语言示例
copy.tagline_en: Process satellite imagery and geospatial data, and build spatial machine learning models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with remote sensing and GIS data and need code examples in multiple languages

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你处理地图和卫星影像数据:计算植被指数、做地形与路网分析、分类影像、读取云端地理数据等。它会给出可直接用的代码示例,并提醒坐标系等注意事项。
howto.when: 当你提出遥感、GIS 分析、地形分析等地理空间任务,或要求处理地球观测数据时触发。

say.text: 把 zones 和 points 做空间连接,按区域统计均值。
say.note: 会生成 GeoPandas 的连接与聚合代码。

say.text: 下载旧金山路网,算两点间最短驾车时间。
say.note: 会调用 OSMnx 与 NetworkX 实现。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process geospatial data: satellite imagery, vegetation indices, terrain and network analysis, image classification, cloud data access. It outputs ready-to-use code and coordinate-system reminders.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for remote sensing workflows, GIS analysis, terrain analysis, or any Earth observation / geospatial computation task.

say_en.text: Compute NDVI from Sentinel-2 in Python and save as GeoTIFF.
say_en.note: It will give complete band-read and calculation code.

say_en.text: Spatial-join zones and points, then summarize mean per zone.
say_en.note: It will use GeoPandas for join and aggregation.

say_en.text: Download San Francisco street network and get shortest driving time.
say_en.note: It will use OSMnx and NetworkX.
